title: WaterColor "Crystal Sands" 128 Needlerush Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 12 wristbands.- Located in the WaterColor Lake District- Steps from community pool and beach access- Carriage house- Foosball table- WiFi- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - 5 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: "Crystal Sands" at 128 Needlerush is a recently updated 5-bedroom / 4.5-bath home nestled in the serenity of the Lake District. This home is the ideal get-away - located steps from the Sand Hill (Froggy) Pool and the Western Lake Pedestrian Bridge with its quick access to the Watercolor Beach Club and the sparkling water and crystal sands of the Gulf. 128 Needlerush is 3,274 square feet featuring four king bedrooms - three of which have private ensuite bathrooms. The home's layout and appointments make it the perfect retreat for 2-3 families vacationing together or a multi-generational reunion. A golf-cart with seating for 6 facilitates outings to Seaside or shopping for all your guests. The first floor includes a large, open, and luxuriously appointed living area that unites the kitchen and dining area with a gracious front porch. The living area includes plenty of seating for movie nights and a large dining table that seats ten plus additional seating for four at the kitchen island. The upscale kitchen includes a Wolf range and plenty of space for families to prepare meals together. The primary suite with king bed is also on the first floor and has a luxurious marble bathroom complete with multi-jet shower. Finishing out the first floor is an oversize laundry/mud-room that includes an enclosed shower and plenty of room for post-beach transitioning. The second floor has 2 additional bedrooms and a playful bunk room that sleeps four. Both additional bedrooms are furnished with king-size beds, vaulted ceilings, and en suite baths - one of which connects to the hall. For those guests who would like additional privacy, the carriage house is beautifully equipped with a king bed, efficiency kitchen, and full bath. "Crystal Sands" at 128 Needlerush is an immaculate home with all the amenities to ensure your next vacation to Watercolor is extraordinary!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/ Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective March 15, 2014, Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 60 vehicles throughout the community at any given time.
